summary: Full backend + frontend UI testing of Leões Guarda-Redes app. 12/12 pytest backend tests passed (auth, CRUD goalkeepers/reports, profile trends >=3 rule, PDF endpoint, export, logo, protected routes). Full Playwright flow validated: login redirects to /registo, protected route enforcement, create new GK via select '__new__', general form fields, all SelectGrid groups (situação/zona/distância/finalização/técnica/decisão multi/seguimento/avaliação) work, amarelo/vermelho reveals action-feedback input, adicionar ação clears form, 4 actions added correctly, offensive counters increment and never go below 0, save-report opens PDF popup and clears actions list, Base de Dados lists GK cards, detail view shows StatCards + auto profile + trends (min 3 occurrences enforced: 'Seguimento mais frequente: GR recuperou (4)'), edit strengths/weaknesses/source save, delete report + delete GK confirm flows, export downloads leoes-export.json. Everything works.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is a single 632-line file - consider splitting into routers (auth/goalkeepers/reports/pdf) for maintainability.
PUT /goalkeepers/{gid} and DELETE /goalkeepers/{gid} don't validate ObjectId format - will throw 500 on malformed id; use try/except to return 400.
PUT /goalkeepers/{gid} doesn't check if the goalkeeper exists (update_one on missing doc silently returns 0 modified) - should return 404 when not found.
DELETE /reports/{rid} and DELETE /goalkeepers/{gid} return {ok: true} even when nothing was deleted - should return 404 if not found.
PDF endpoint uses attachment Content-Disposition which forces download instead of inline view; frontend does window.open expecting inline preview. Consider 'inline' for better UX.
Startup hook uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handlers (FastAPI recommends since 0.93).
compute_profile trend loop breaks on first non-Enquadramento decision >=3; consider listing all or top-N for richer analysis.
No pagination on /api/goalkeepers, /api/export (5000 hard limit) - fine for MVP but note it.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ prefixed goalkeepers/reports were cleaned up after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover auth + CRUD + PDF + trends. Frontend Registo flow: use data-testid sel-<group>-<option-lowercased-with-dashes>. Adding actions requires small waits (~200ms) between tile clicks - clicking too fast can miss state updates in React (observed 2/3 rows initially, 4/4 with 150ms waits). PDF opens in new tab via window.open to /api/reports/{id}/pdf (attachment header).
